关键词: Canadian Banks and Life Insurance Companies
主要内容: Royal Bank of Canada, along with other Canadian banks and life insurance companies, issued a joint statement regarding changes to annual meeting planning. The statement highlights proactive measures taken in response to the COVID-19 pandemic, including obtaining a court order to hold annual meetings via electronic means. The health and well-being of employees, clients, investors, and communities are emphasized as a collective priority.
